spec.description: Instant view of how much CPU and memory is reserved, how much is really used, and how close each cluster is to running out of schedulable capacity.

spec.title: CPU requested
spec.description: Cores reserved by pod requests across the selected scope.

spec.title: CPU utilisation
spec.description: Used over requested. Low means we are paying for cores nobody burns.

spec.title: Memory requested
spec.description: Bytes reserved by pod requests across the selected scope.

spec.title: Memory actually used
spec.description: Working set actually resident right now.

spec.title: CPU requests against allocatable, by cluster
spec.description: How much of each cluster's schedulable CPU is already committed. Approaching 100% means the next pod will not schedule, regardless of how little is actually being used.

spec.title: Memory requests against allocatable, by cluster
spec.description: How much of each cluster's schedulable memory is already committed.

spec.title: Namespaces closest to their CPU requests
spec.description: Usage over requests, highest first. Above 1 the namespace is burning more than it reserved and is a throttling risk; these are the ones to size UP, not down.

spec.title: Namespaces closest to their memory requests
spec.description: Working set over requests, highest first. Above 1 the namespace is an OOM-kill risk.

spec.title: FinOps - Compute (CPU & RAM) - State - Headroom

spec.name: max_shown
spec.label: Max namespaces shown
spec.description: How many namespaces the two lower tables list, most loaded first.
